newsitem.title: USA: Magellan Health issues proxy on Crescent.
newsitem.headline: Magellan Health issues proxy on Crescent.

text.p: Magellan Health Services Inc said Thursday that it has filed its definitive proxy materials with the Securities and Exchange Commission, which include discussions of its proposed transaction with Crescent Real Estate Equities Co.
The company said it expects to distribute the proxy on April 25 and ask shareholders to approve the Crescent transaction at its annual shareholders' meeting, May 30.

The deal with Crescent, said the company, includes the sale of of its physical assets to Crescent for $400 million, and the operation of these facilities in a 50/50 joint venture with a Crescent spinoff.

Magellan's businesses include Charter Behavioral Health Systems, a behavioral healthcare delivery system with nearly 100 facilities delivering inpatient and outpatient care, and majority-owned Green Spring Health Services, a leader in behavioral managed care services.
